name: Aeropress Coffee Maker
description:
Simple ,  portable  and  easy to use , the  AeroPress  has quickly become one of the  cult faves for coffee fans worldwide .  
 With a  deep immersion  and a  short steep time , it gives  full-bodied cups  of coffee that are  low on bitterness and high on flavour .  
 Strained by using pressure to push the brew through a  microfilter paper discs , the Aeropress can easily brew  light, delicious black coffee  as well as  thick concentrated homebrews  that are closer to espresso territory.  
 Since it's made from  Phthalate and BPA free plastic , it's super  resilient  and ridiculously  easy to clean  too! Remember that last brewer that broke in the sink? Yeah, that's never happening again. Ever.  
 If you're looking for a brewer you can take with you everywhere you go to satisfy your chase for mindblowing coffee whenever you want it -  this is it .  
 
 Assembled measurements:  9 1/2" h X 4" w X 4" d  
 Each AeroPress Kit includes: 
 
 
   AeroPress Plunger   
 
   Chamber     
   Lid    
 
 
 
   Funnel   
 
 
   Scoop   
 
 
   Stirrer   
 
 
   350 microfilters discs   
 
   Filter holder

name: AEROPRESS GO
description:
We think the team at the  Aerobie  office was looking at their award-winning Aeropress and wondering, " Hmm. What if the AeroPress...had a mini-me? "  
  Because that's pretty much  exactly  what the  AeroPress GO  is all about. With a couple of tweaks thrown in to make it more suited to home espresso-like brewing.  
 If the AeroPress was  light ,  compact  and  portable , the  AeroPress GO  is   lighter  ,   compact-er   and   portable-er  . Yes, we just made up those words. Deal with it.   
  Being small isn't its only superpower. The Go also comes with a  super dope foldable stirrer  and a  cool little box  that can hold up to  15-20 filters  and snaps shut! The kit now also comes with a  plastic mug  and a  rubber lid  that you can  brew your coffee into  and then use it to house the entire kit into  one neat storage unit .   
  If AeroPress was looking to make something that was on point for  travelling ,  camping  or just be easier to be  outdoors and drink cafe level coffee  - they nailed it!  
  AeroPress GO Dimensions:  3.7 x 3.7 x 5.3 inches

name: Genmai
description:

name: Noir
description:
70% Dark Dominican Cacao, Volcanic Salt     
 
  A good way to identify  high-quality chocolate , like the fantastic  Dominican single-origin dark chocolate  in this bar, is to see if it comes packed with flavours of its own. Some bars are great just by themselves and this is definitely one of them.   
   Topped off with a  light sprinkle of volcanic salt  [did you expect any less by now?], this bar keeps it simple and lets the cocoa sing with notes of  pineapple ,  pecans  and  earl grey .

name: Smoke
description:
70% Dark Madagascar Cacao, Cherry Wood, Candied Orange Peel   
   Dark chocolate  and  orange  is a  celebrated combo  that sits comfortably in the hearts of chocolate fans everywhere. So when Chef Prateek decided to take a stab at it, he knew he had to  elevate the game .   
   70% Madagascar   single-origin  gets smoked overnight in  cherry wood  before being paired with  in-house candied organic Malta orange . The smoke hits first and disappears while the orange hangs around for the party in your tastebuds.

name: Starlet
description:
Ruby, Raspberry Chocolate, Rosepetal

   Elegance commands attention without needing to demand it and this bar knows that well.  Bold raspberry body  for the red,  yoghurt  for the creaminess and  rose petals  for a burst of complementary flavour.   
   In case you’re wondering, yes, it does taste as good as it looks.

name: Surprise Me!
description:
For some of us, the joy is consistency but for others, the joy is in the chaos!   
 Sign up for our subscription with this option and get sent a different bag with every delivery. Our Indian coffees go through a huuuuuuge spectrum of taste notes from the usual dark chocolate to the more out-there flavours like figs and malt.  
 Now with auto-debit, the quickest, easiest and simplest way to try our entire bean catalogue is just one click away. 
 Should you find a favourite from the list, feel free to edit your subscription from the very next order. The choice is always yours.

name: Timemore Black Mirror Scale
description:

  ?Scratch-resistant & Wear-resistant?The home baking kitchen scale adopts a delicate matte texture design to make it more scratch-resistant and wear-resistant for a long time using. This hand coffee scale is easy to clean and store without worrying about scratching the coffee weighing platform.  
  ?Stylish & Simple? The espresso scale uses a natural, integrated, stylish, and simple design that displays time and weight information. It perfectly matches modern homes and brings you a more convenient and comfortable experience.

name: Timemore Crystal Eye Dripper
description:
Time More Dripper is designed with a concave principle, the lower area of the dripper, instead of slowing down the brew actually increases, making the water flow more smoothly and the extraction more uniform.  
  1 - Insulating level - the filter paper completely attached to the smooth top part of the dripper so water cannot get through.  
  2 - Brewing level - where the brewing action should take place.  
  3 - Powder level - the ground coffee will fill the bottom area which is less ribbed and more flume to encourage the water flow and thus reducing the chance of over extracting.
